description: Set up a standing watch that delivers newly discovered matching sites on a schedule. Narrow it by technology, keyword, category, country, distance from a place or whether the site publishes a contact route; a completely unfiltered watch needs a plan that allows the every-site stream. Free to create, but delivered sites count against the monthly site allowance, and plans limit how many watches, technologies and keywords you may have. A webhook watch returns its signing secret exactly once when it is created.

cadence.description: How often to deliver: instant, daily or weekly. Defaults to daily for email and instant for webhook or slack; portal stores the value but does not deliver.

categories.description: Restrict to several product categories. A site matches if it is in ANY of them.

category.description: Restrict to a product category. For several, use categories.

channel.description: Delivery channel: email, webhook, slack, or portal for no outbound delivery. Default email.

countries.description: Restrict to several countries, each an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or a name, e.g. ["GB", "Ireland"]. A site matches if it is in ANY of them.

country.description: Restrict to a country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or a name. For several, use countries.

hasContactEmail.description: Only sites that have a published contact email (true), or only those that do not (false). Omit for no filter. Needs the 'contacts' permission.

hasContactPage.description: Only sites that have a published contact page (true), or only those that do not (false). Omit for no filter; set both to require both. Needs the 'contacts' permission.

keywords.description: Whole words to look for in a site's name, title or description, e.g. photogrammetry. Matches ANY of them; a multi-word entry is a phrase. Three characters or more. A common word is refused as too broad, with an estimate of what it would deliver. Combines with a technology: 'Stripe and photogrammetry' fits on every plan.

near.description: Only sites near a place: a town or city, a postcode, or 'lat,lng', e.g. Bristol. Use with radius. Sites we could not place never match.

radius.description: How far from near, e.g. 30mi or 50km (a bare number is km). From 5 to 248 miles (8 to 400 km).

technologies.description: Technologies to watch, by name. A site matches if it uses ANY of them.

technologiesAll.description: Also require ALL of these technologies.

technologiesExcluding.description: Exclude sites using any of these technologies.

webhookUrl.description: Full HTTPS delivery URL, required for webhook or slack. It is stored encrypted; list_watches later returns only its host, never its path or query.

name: create_watch
title: Create a watch
